root_cause_class: graph-conditioned application metadata corruption, not an unresolved HIP runtime defect
scope: GPT-OSS-120B TP4 base runtime below AR+RMSNorm
supersession: Fault-address underflow geometry, a positive slot-0 alias control, and post-fix formal gates identify ordinary graph padding aliasing live request slot 0. See graph-padding-sentinel-root-cause.json.

decisive_failure.configuration: fusion off, 0.90 HBM, C32 decode graph only, eager prefill, passive health, overlap disabled, explicit copy-in
decisive_failure.phase: first measured one-token warmup after server readiness

evidence: Three fresh post-fault fully eager canonical servers passed.
Earlier fully eager 0.95 three-seed controls passed.
C32 faults reproduced with fusion and standalone Triton all-reduce disabled.

memory_pressure.evidence: At 0.95, capping only KV capacity removed a reproducible boundary; a later 0.90/C32 unfused arm still faulted.

hardware_and_placement.ecc_ras: zero correctable, uncorrectable, and deferred counts for UMC, SDMA, GFX, MMHUB, and XGMI-WAFL on canonical selected GPUs
hardware_and_placement.pcie: zero replay, recovery, rollover, and NAK counters
hardware_and_placement.conclusion: No single physical GPU is isolated as defective. A drained GPU reset is no longer required to resolve this incident because the application metadata mechanism was reproduced directly and fixed.

falsified_sufficient_causes: torch.topk alone in a small raw graph

diagnostic_limit.gpu_coredump: HSA inherited an unavailable host pipe handler; a direct dump could consume a prohibitive fraction of the remaining 373 GiB disk and was not enabled on four 225+ GiB processes
diagnostic_limit.upstream_context: Known ROCm/PyTorch raw and inductor HIP graph faults exist for large graphs and selected captured operations; the standalone topk transition stress passed in this environment.

decision.qualification_status: completed: three restart blocks and fifteen pairs without a safety failure
decision.deployment_outcome: fusion remains opt-in because paired decode performance regressed
decision.reopen_condition: not applicable; this intermediate diagnosis is superseded
